description: The guest crossed a memory threshold (edge-triggered: one record per crossing, re-armed only after the value stayed under half the threshold for 5 min; at most one per kind per 10 min and ten memory events per contract); sent as the payload of a market.event. Guest-originated only. It carries no secret. The host-side counterpart is compute.events.vm.memoryPressure.

kind.description: What crossed: psi, /proc/pressure/memory some avg10; swap, the share of the guest's swap in use.

threshold.description: The crossed threshold, in hundredths of a percent (psi: of some avg10; swap: of swapTotal).

psiSomeAvg10.description: /proc/pressure/memory some avg10, in hundredths of a percent; absent without PSI.

psiFullAvg10.description: /proc/pressure/memory full avg10, in hundredths of a percent; absent without PSI.
